In something of a surprising twist, a PlayStation rep told the site there will be no layoffs as a result of the cancellation, as Haven will "shift its focus to collaborating with other development teams across PlayStation Studios, while also exploring new creative opportunities."

While it was announced three years ago, work on Fairgames appears to have started even further back, in 2021.

Fairgames itself looked to be in trouble in 2025 when Raymond departed Haven, reportedly after an external playtest left PlayStation leadership "concerned about how the game was received and its progress."

The Bloomberg report says a more recent large-scale playtest produced similar results.
